summary: Fisherman near Corral Creek developed heat-exhaustion and altitude-sickness symptoms; call reported ~4:45 p.m. His companion hiked back to a vehicle and drove to the nearest 911 call box. Larimer County Sheriff's Office personnel and Larimer County Search and Rescue volunteers reached the patient on foot, gave care, and helped him hike the rugged terrain back to the trailhead, finishing near midnight.
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office; Larimer County Search and Rescue
notes: Third of three same-day Larimer County rescues on 2024-07-10; the day's other two incidents (Crosier Mountain medical airlift; Greyrock Trail ~100-ft fall) already indexed as ids 1392/1393.
